verdict: Round 6 stands up to my own measurements. Nothing old moved, the 14 page entries agree with screen.json and prompts6.json, the manifest validates, the pick rule reproduces to 0.005 dB and 0.0006 on all 43 kept files of the three loud families, and a second run of screen.py on copies gives the same picks for round 6 and for round 5. Not clean: the suite of tools/sound has one failing test (known, caused by the 8 g_* sounds of generated.json), the intent line of the two hull_light entries says the prompt was accepted in round 4 when it was accepted in round 5, and RESULTS6.md named only two picks as close to the level threshold when three are (I corrected that text). Hand skips reproduce, with one caveat about the hull count. Nobody listened; nothing here says how anything sounds.

points.point: 4. Every pick: cut, ends, level, peak, length
points.evidence: Published wavs, 14 picks. Level by own BS.1770 (tools/audio/synth/levels.py lufs): error to target -0.015 to +0.030 LU (largest +0.030 for ev6_1_hull_light_2); within 0.05 for all 14, limitedByPeak false for all. True peak (4x oversampled): -20.12 to -1.60 dBFS; the highest is ev6_3_shield_tight_3 at -1.60, under the ceiling -1.1. First and last sample: at most 6.1e-05 (-84 dB) at both ends; no flat top (longest run of equal extreme samples 2, rule is 3). Last 50 ms against the loudest 4 ms: 30.0 to 58.0 dB under in the published files (lowest margins fold_jump_1 30.0, thruster_mighty_2 36.2, thruster_mighty_3 36.3, thruster_mighty_1 36.9) and 26.0 to 54.2 on the raw cuts: all at least 20 dB, so none is cut off by the README rule. The three thruster picks and fold_jump_1/fold_exit_1 are cut at the family length (1.5 s, 3.8 s) and have already fallen 26 to 36 dB there. Length 0.12 to 3.81 s: hull 0.48 and 0.66, thruster 1.51, 1.51, 1.51, shield 0.27, 0.92, 0.12, fold 3.81 x3 for jump and exit 3.81, 3.13, 3.75. Second event in the one-event families (hull_light, shield_tight): my region test (10 ms windows, regions within 15 dB of the maximum separated by 80 ms under -25 dB) finds exactly 1 region in all 5 picks, and the 50 ms level never falls under -20 dB and rises above -12 dB again. Caveat: the count of 10 ms envelope peaks within 20 dB does not separate the hull skip from the picks: the two hull picks 6 and 5 on the raw cut (8 and 6 in the published files), the skipped s23 11, and the round-5 file the owner accepted (ev5_1_hull_light_1) 9, the one he called echo-like (ev5_1_hull_light_2) 8. So '11 peaks within 20 dB' in the skip text is not a rule; what sets s23 apart is the second cluster at 0.6 to 0.8 s of a 1.19 s cut. Share above 60 Hz of the cut equals screen.json (hull 100.0 and 94.9, thruster 48.6, 74.2, 95.7, shield 88.8, 50.2, 98.9, fold 85.1, 99.9, 99.9, 99.9, 43.0, 36.8 %); only the two fold_exit picks 2 and 3 and the shield_tight_2 pick are under 60 %, none under the 10 % rule, and shield_tight picks are over the family's 40 % minimum. Content, by measurement only: ev6_2_thruster_mighty_1 (prompt 'single shot') holds about ten separate pulses within 12 dB of its maximum between 0.5 and 1.1 s on a 5 ms envelope, so it is a burst; the family allows several events, but the pick does not answer the single-shot prompt. ev6_3_shield_tight_1 has real steps in its own samples at 0.1905 to 0.1907 s (about 0.03 per sample against a median of 0.0001), the clicks audition-check reported.

All 8 reproduced on the cut stored in screen.json. hull_light_1 s23: cut 1.193 s; 50 ms level -19.4 dB under max at 0.15 s, -12.1 to -11.3 at 0.20 to 0.30 s, -20.0 / -17.8 at 0.60 / 0.70 s; 11 envelope peaks within 20 dB (0.02, 0.13, 0.21, 0.26, 0.31, 0.38, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.74, 0.78 s). shield_tight_2 s12: 0.121 s, peak 0.999, loudest 50 ms -3.88 dBFS, 84.5 % at 250 to 1000 Hz (Hann spectrum; 91.5 % rectangular), 30.8 % within 25 Hz of 810 Hz, 0.04 % under 250 Hz, dominant 809.9 Hz. fold_jump_3 s12 2.7 % above 60 Hz (rectangular spectrum; 1.7 % with Hann), dominant 22.1 Hz. fold_exit_1 s12 4.4 % above 60 Hz, dominant 22.1 Hz. fold_jump_3 s14 8.7 %. Steady tone: s13 level within 6 dB of its maximum for 2.80 s, s15 2.70 s, s16 2.45 s (50 ms windows); s14 2.35 s; dominant 47.6, 67.1, 35.8 Hz; one 50 Hz band holds 87.0 % (s13), 57.0 % with a Hann spectrum (66.8 % rectangular; s15), 80.9 % (s16); under 60 Hz 84.0 %, 77.5 %. Differences: '98 % under 60 Hz' for fold_jump_3 s12 is 97.3 % on the same spectrum that gives 2.7 % above (98.3 % with Hann); '97 %' for fold_exit_1 s12 is 95.6 % on that spectrum (96.5 % with Hann); '79 % under 60 Hz' for s16 is 77.5 %. These are rounding and window choices; they change no skip. Every kept file of the prompt fold_jump_3 (s12 to s16; s11 was thrown out) is skipped, so that prompt has no pick, as RESULTS6 says. The three s13/s15/s16 skips rest on 'steady tone' judged by level and spectrum only; the envelope of each still has 100 to 130 ripple peaks within 20 dB, so 'steady' is a statement about the 50 ms level, not about modulation.
